question: Which statement about American foreign policy immediately after World War II is most accurate?

options.B: The United States remained in European affairs and soon committed to containment
options.C: The United States refused to join the United Nations because it feared losing sovereignty
options.D: The United States demobilized and stayed neutral toward the Soviet Union until the 1960s
